title: Structured Incident Hand-off Composer: multi-channel attachments & postmortem seed
creator: Liam Chen
description:
Goal:
Build a lightweight composer service that generates a structured incident hand-off package for Ops channels (PagerDuty brief, Slack incident thread attachment, and an initial postmortem seed). The composer will pull contextual artifacts (sampled traces, top metrics slices, recent error logs, scoreboard latency histograms) and stitch them into small, actionable attachments plus a markdown postmortem draft with suggested impact, hypothesis, and next steps.

Why this now:
- On-call run rate shows many incidents stall during triage because responders must manually gather traces and metric slices.
- We want faster time-to-ack + better postmortem signal to reduce regression slips.

Scope (MVP):
1) PagerDuty brief card payload generator (compact) with: incident summary, top 3 traces (links + brief fingerprint), latency P95/P99 slice, error-rate delta, suggested rollback commands (if present in playbook catalog).
2) Slack incident attachment builder that posts an initial thread message with embedded diagnostics links and 1-click actions (create postmortem, run pre-approved rollback).
3) Postmortem seed generator: structured markdown file with fields for timeline, hypothesis, mitigations, and links to evidence. Seed saved to /postmortems/drafts and linked in Slack/PagerDuty.
4) Pluggable extractors for traces (sampled spans), metrics snapshots, and top log snippets.

Non-goals (MVP):
- Full automated remediation (we will only surface suggested commands).
- Long-term evidence bundling retention policies (handled later by evidence service).

Acceptance criteria:
- Composer creates a PD brief payload under 1s for incidents with <= 3 candidate traces and <= 200ms extra latency overhead on hot path.
- Slack attachment renders correctly in #ops with the evidence links and a single button to create a postmortem draft.
- Postmortem draft contains event timeline, top 3 signals, and an initial hypothesis field filled by the composer template.
- Unit tests for trace/metric extractor mocks and integration test with a PD staging tenant.

Technical approach:
- New small stateless service (composer) behind the ops-telemetry mesh. Triggered by telemetry-rule => incident webhook consumer.
- Use sampling policy to pick 3 representative traces (highest error score + diversity heuristic).
- Query metrics-timeseries for the 10m window around incident start, compute P50/P95/P99 and change-from-baseline.
- Use log tailer to surface up to 5 most relevant log lines (ranked by anomaly score).
- Render templates server-side using handlebars-style templates stored in repo. Templates for PD, Slack, and PM seed.
- Security: composer uses service account with read-only access to telemetry stores and a short-lived signed URL generator for attachments.

Rollout plan:
- Stage 1: dev-only with simulated incidents (2 engineers, 1 week) -> internal QA.
- Stage 2: PD staging tenant + canary Slack channel (ops-team) for 2 weeks.
- Stage 3: Gradual enable for low-risk customers and internal infra teams, monitor false-positive rates and overhead.

Monitoring and metrics:
- Composer latency histogram, error rate, PD brief generation rate, and percent of incidents that create postmortem draft.
- Business metric: mean time to triage for incidents with composer vs without.

Security and compliance notes:
- Evidence links expire in 7 days by default. For customer incidents that require retention change, fallback to evidence-retainer workflow.
- Because attachments may contain traces with PII, we will run the trace scrubber pipeline before exposing links.

Open decisions and trade-offs:
- How aggressive should the trace sampling be? (Trade-off: completeness vs payload size). Proposal: start with up to 3 traces chosen by highest anomaly score + diversity.
- Should composer try to auto-fill hypothesis with ML suggestions? For MVP we will use deterministic heuristics and a single suggestion slot; ML enrichment is a follow-up.

Next steps / actions:
- Design doc and templates: link to Confluence (https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Structured+Incident+Hand-off+Composer).
- Spike: implement trace extractor + PD payload formatter (ENG-73001-spike branch).
- PR for initial composer: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/4822
